First Appeared: @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.YxfxYfYC1hm9ZNiA]{Session 4}
Status: Active
Affiliation: @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.Iz0ZE5ZJtcXABZl7]{Order of the First Dawn}, @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.Iz0ZE5ZJtcXABZl7]{The Light}

Description

Leader of the @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.Iz0ZE5ZJtcXABZl7]{Order of the First Dawn}, a small but respected Luciferian paladinic order stationed at the Chryseum in @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.E6jtdcGA7bfRGvuj]{Aurelion}.
A woman who commands respect among other paladinic orders.
She holds a complex faith: loyal to @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.Iz0ZE5ZJtcXABZl7]{Lucifer} as the light of civilization, but believes his suppression of ruin was a well-intentioned mistake that caused the world to stagnate.
She views ruin and renewal as natural forces that must coexist.

Role

Brenn and her order are protecting @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.9r800oi2AazmBBPq]{Luminary Severin Morrow} from the Church's Inquisition.
She is one of the five heralds who felt the interlocking connection at the @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.E6jtdcGA7bfRGvuj]{Shrine of Renewal}, confirming her as a herald of renewal.
She shared a radical theology with the party — that Lucifer's suppression of ruin caused renewal to go dormant, leading to centuries of civilizational decline with nothing rising to replace what crumbled.

Relationships

  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.Iz0ZE5ZJtcXABZl7]{Order of the First Dawn} — Her paladinic order; she leads them
  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.9r800oi2AazmBBPq]{Luminary Severin Morrow} — Ally; she protects him from the Inquisition
  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.Iz0ZE5ZJtcXABZl7]{The Light} — Complex loyalty; honors Lucifer but acknowledges the limits of his ascension
  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.s4ABoIqxcgBnmTYz]{Sir Roderic Lightbearer} — Fellow paladin; negotiated passage with him at the Chryseum
  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.Iz0ZE5ZJtcXABZl7]{Corona Vigil} — The Inquisition investigating Severin; Brenn stands against them

Key Events

  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.YxfxYfYC1hm9ZNiA]{Session 4} — Confronted the party in the Chryseum's grand nave; shared her heterodox theology about ruin and renewal; confirmed as a herald of renewal at the @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.E6jtdcGA7bfRGvuj]{Shrine of Renewal}; traveled with the combined heralds through the tunnels where their presence created a fragile equilibrium
  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.c5SHL7wB7yKbx7cP]{Session 5} — Stayed in the tunnels with @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.9r800oi2AazmBBPq]{Severin} to avoid arrest; fought alongside @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.eNop3Y7Qd04NHq5f]{Garland} to eliminate Harlequins in the @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.E6jtdcGA7bfRGvuj]{The Chryseum}; participated in the gathering of all six heralds that opened the cocoon

Session Appearances

  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.YxfxYfYC1hm9ZNiA]{Session 4}
  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.c5SHL7wB7yKbx7cP]{Session 5}
